title: A QX_PING request that arrives while an earlier one is still unanswered is chargeable (only the largest is answered); a flood trips the budget

text: 4096 requests in four records with no response in between: the first arrives with no response owed and is free; each of the other 4095 arrives while one is owed and is charged (only the last request is answered); one token is left.
The response to 4095 has been written. Of the next three requests in one record the first is free and the other two are charged: the budget goes below zero.
